title: The Blood Pact
start: Talk to Xenia, in the Lumbridge cemetery.

rewards.t: Access to the Lumbridge Catacombs, which include:
The mask of Dragith Nurn (The 5 parts it can be assembled from can be found by killing the monsters in the catacombs)
6 demon statuettes in the catacombs, which Xenia will buy from you for a total of 2500 coins
Xenia can also tell you history about the Catacombs and Dragith Nurn
Reese's sword and its off-hand counterpart
Helmet of trials; requires 300 quest points, can be received at any point

steps.t: Start the quest by talking to Xenia in the Lumbridge graveyard. [Chat: 1 What help do you need? › 1 I'll help you. › Accept]
After a cutscene, proceed north. [Chat: 4 I can handle this.]

sub.t: Talk to Xenia if there is no dialogue.

steps.t: Defeat Kayle then talk to him. [Chat: 2 Yes. Now die!]

sub.t: (Optional) Equip it if you don't have any Magic, Ranged, or Necromancy weapon.

steps.t: Head west, open the tomb door, and then go through it.
Go south and operate the winch.
Talk to Caitlin. [Chat: 2 Time for you to die!]
Go down one of the stairs to the west. [Chat: Any]
Defeat Reese and talk to him. [Chat: 2 Time for you to die!]

p: Dragith Nurn's tomb is destroyed with Reese's death.

steps.t: A cutscene will occur. [Chat: 1 I'm ready for my reward.]

p: Ilona being held hostage by the cult.
